title: Woman Gets Caught Swatting Walmart to Avoid Arrest
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On December 2, 2022, Monroe County Sheriff deputies responded to a residence to locate a male and female who had warrants in Tomah, WI. As they tried to make contact with the female at the residence, she initially refused to come out. Eventually, she called 911 to report an emergency at Walmart in an attempt to get the deputies to leave. She soon admitted to making the false report. Shortly after, they observed her suspicious behavior and believed the male was possibly in the vicinity. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public. 

💥Want to see more content? 
Join Patreon for many exciting features such as early access/ad-free content, exclusive content, behind-the-scenes, giveaways, and much more!
👉 https://www.patreon.com/codebluecam

► Facebook
https://www.facebook.com/CodeBlueCam/

► Twitter
https://twitter.com/codebluecam

For general questions or to leave an anonymous tip contact:
contact@codebluecam.com

Narrated by Brian Buckley
https://www.brianbuckleyvoice.com
